scope: Theorem 2.5 (Components and deformation theory) of the manuscript “Rationality of the Canonical Unramified Arthur Filtration” (preprints/Rationality-of-the-Canonical-Unramified-Arthur-Filtration-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eaf8e38720714e23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every connected component Zσ of the restricted local-system stack has a unique semisimple isomorphism class σ. Its automorphism group J = Aut(σ) is reductive, possibly disconnected. There is a formal affine coarse space Sσ with reduced space a point, and Zσ → Sσ is relatively algebraic. After choosing a frame at a geometric point, the component is formal affine. For an affine infinitesimal stage Sn → Sσ, its base change is affine; almost finite type stages and bounded Postnikov truncations may be used. These affine stages have coherent cohomology in each bounded range. The tangent complex at a local system τ is Tτ LocSysrestr b G (X) ≃ RΓ(X, b gτ )[1]. (2.4) In particular the stack is quasi-smooth.
